scope: Two documented US actions on 8 March 2026, selected to test the claim that no street mobilisation occurred. Not a census, attendance estimate, time series, or evidence of nationwide turnout.

events.title: “Believe Survivors”
events.text: Demonstrators gather outside Trump Tower for a “Believe Survivors” march on International Women’s Day.

events.title: Zorro Ranch
events.text: Virginia Giuffre's brothers join activists outside Epstein's former ranch, calling for unredacted records and further investigation.
